page.layout: One printed page. Running head centred at top: "PRÆFATIO." Main text in one column at right. Marginal notes in the left margin, beside the lines of the text.

main_text.p: tholicæ gloriantes, veram & verè Catholicam Ecclesiam, & pios quoslibet Diuini verbi puritatem amplexos, totos iam annos septuaginta crudeliter infectantur. Longum esset iter ad omnia, quæ, & aliud tempus, & longiorem orationem desiderant. Sed, vt in rem præsentem veniamus: nónne ipsâ Missæ sacrificium, Christi sacrificio contrarium.Missæ sacrificium (aduersus quod instituta hæc nostra est disputatio) ipsius Christi sacrificio tantas offudit tenebras, vt præcipuum hoc fidei caput pro pè in obliuionem abierit? Nónne istud hominum commentum (quæ est humanæ superstitionis fœcunditas) in tot & tam multiplices cæremonias, tot gestus, tot signa: tot denique, tantaque, scilicet, mysteria penitus abstrusa, ac ne ipsis quidem Pontificiis sacerdotibus cognita, tandem excreuit: vt tibi videaris in Numæ schola & in veterum Pontificum Romanorum collegio, potius quàm in Apostolorum doctrina, & in Ecclesia Christiana versari? Nam quid commemorem variam Varie ac multiplices cæremoniæ Missæ: eædemque cum ineptæ tum perabsurdæ.Missalis sacerdotis actione, variósque gestus ac motus corporis in suo illo sacrificio Missalis sacerdotis actio, status, gestus.

page.notes: Marginal notes in the left margin, transcribed in place as printed; the text of the notes is in small italic type and partly worn. The last line of the page reads "crificio" at the foot of the column. Several marginal words are difficult to read and may be imperfect.
